Notes:
- Driving totals 384 minutes (car1 138, car2 246). The only deferral is one elderly person at Kispang care home (penalty 50). Rescuing that person would need a separate 62-minute round trip, which costs more than the penalty.
- Syaphru school is not used, because it is not a designated evacuation point.
- The Benighat–Trishuli road, the Benighat–Syaphru road and the Suryagadhi–Trishuli road are excluded as blocked.
- Verify the plan against the field report before deployment, since several roads are described as muddy or debris-strewn.
